best_lineage.idea: Replace the O(n log n) merge sort with a hybrid approach: detect sorted/reverse in O(n) for early exit, then use LSD radix sort with 11-bit passes (1-3 passes depending on max value) using a ping-pong buffer, which is O(n) for random and duplicate-heavy data and handles all distributions far better than comparison sort.
